name: Breach and Clear
blurb: Clear the work site, then grab as much as you can carry.

stages.log_text: Sounds like we need to clear out the creatures that have taken over this work site. Time to lock and load.
The nasties are gone, but it sounds like we all need to get to a safe spot ASAP!
So, it sounds like we can take whatever we want! Time search the containers for riches!
Last chance to collect materials from the machine!
